credentialRules.description: Do not claim licenses, registrations, clearances, certificates, union membership, right-to-work status, flight hours, clinical authority, or legal authority unless found in CV evidence or user-confirmed.
When a credential is location-specific, ask the user to confirm jurisdiction before using it in generated output.
For portfolio-led roles, prefer named project evidence or portfolio URLs over generic CV claims.
For academic CVs, preserve publication, grant, and conference details exactly unless the user edits them.

confirmationPrompts: Which jurisdiction are you admitted or licensed to practise in?
Do you hold any current legal practising certificate or bar admission relevant to this role?
domainProfiles.label: Legal / regulated legal services

confirmationPrompts: Which clinical licenses or registrations do you currently hold?
Which jurisdiction or state are those credentials valid in?
domainProfiles.label: Clinical healthcare

confirmationPrompts: Which aviation certificates, ratings, or medical class do you currently hold?
What flight hours or aircraft type ratings are explicitly supported by your CV?
domainProfiles.label: Aviation safety-sensitive

confirmationPrompts: Do you currently hold an active clearance, and what level can you truthfully disclose?
Are there citizenship or right-to-work requirements that need confirmation?
domainProfiles.label: Government / clearance-sensitive

confirmationPrompts: Do you want to add publications, grants, or conference talks that are missing from your CV?
Do you have an ORCID or publication list URL?
domainProfiles.label: Academic / research

confirmationPrompts: What portfolio URL or selected projects should DraftApply reference?
Which 2-3 projects best prove fit for this role?
domainProfiles.label: Creative / portfolio-led

confirmationPrompts: Which trade licenses, cards, or safety certifications do you currently hold?
Which jurisdiction, union, or site-access requirements apply?
domainProfiles.label: Licensed trade / manual specialist

confirmationPrompts: Add 2-3 achievements relevant to this role.
Paste a fuller job description or list the top requirements if you have them.
domainProfiles.label: Sparse CV or vague job description
